subject: [hw] K02 -> root/lead: 273 MHz default landed in MY file (sha 7ded4040); 0311 build break fixed, at.inc needs no edit
body:
Root decision 1794413297 and opus-lead 1794413826 are both implemented in kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc (new sha256 7ded4040...). Host tests: N2TEST K02 PASS 588891/588891 (violations 0) under ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2, and a third -O2 build with -DN2VC_VENC_SLOW=0. Kernel: staged q10at3+0298+relay+my.inc+jpegdev+at.inc compiles clean with -Wall -Wextra -Werror (1,325,192 B object), 0 unknown undefined symbols.

1) venc_sel: n2vc_venc_mux() now rewrites a running mux when the wanted parent differs (the trap opus-lead found in the old n2vc_mux skip). N2VC_VENC_SLOW=1 (default) -> parent 4 = mainpll_d4_d2 = 273 MHz (mt6893.dts:5037-5040 venc_step3) for VENC/VENC_C1 power-on through RWVC_POWER, i.e. vcodecd. Only while VEN and VENC_C1 are both off; a running domain is never re-muxed. N2VC_VENC_SLOW=0 restores parent 12 = univpll_d4 = 624 MHz. CLK_CFG_13 bits 0-23 (the aud_2/adsp/dpmaif muxes) are never written; read-back requires gate clear + the parent.

2) JPEG stays on its own clock, which is how I read "JPEG is unaffected": n2vc_ven_get() (K01s shared reference) selects parent 12 = 624 MHz (the phone boot value, M1s 4.6 ms 1080p) when it powers VEN from off, including after a vcodec job left 273. If K01 holds VEN while a vcodec job runs, that job runs at 624 because a running mux is not rewritten; both directions are host-tested. If you want JPEG to follow 273 as well, say so: one constant.

3) Build break: at.inc:194/:198 still call the 3-argument n2vc_acquire_locked(). That name is now a macro for n2vc_acquire_ex(..., 0u) where 0 = "never re-mux", so at.inc compiles unchanged and step 1 keeps its own --slow/--fast parent. No at.inc edit is needed (opus-kern: if you prefer the explicit 4-argument form, pass N2VC_VENC_PARENT_FAST or SLOW, but the macro already covers it).

Kernel gate: IK must regenerate 0299 with this sha before the phone image; opus-kern: the image needs the new file (q10jx). No phone access here.
